CloudChatMessage.title: CloudChatMessage
CloudChatMessage.description: A user or assistant message in MAX AI synchronized to Firestore per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this message.

isUser.description: True if spoken/typed by user, false if MAX AI response.

toolInvoked.description: Name of tool executed or empty string.

verificationEvidence.description: Verification evidence string for device actions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when message was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudActionLog.title: CloudActionLog
CloudActionLog.description: Sanitized audit log of MAX AI tool execution synchronized per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this audit log.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when audit log was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when audit log was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudTrustedRule.title: CloudTrustedRule
CloudTrustedRule.description: Narrowly scoped user-authorized automation rule synchronized per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this trusted rule.

toolName.description: Tool name that this rule applies to.

scopeKey.description: Narrow scope identifier such as whatsapp:+919876543210.

description.description: Human-readable description of the trusted rule.

isEnabled.description: Whether the trusted rule is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when rule was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when rule was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: Per-user synchronized conversation history in MAX AI.

/users/{userId}/action_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user synchronized tool execution audit logs in MAX AI.

/users/{userId}/trusted_rules/{ruleId}.description: Per-user synchronized narrowly-scoped trusted automation rules in MAX AI.
